capabilities: Upload Markdown notes to Confluence pages
Configure Confluence domain and Atlassian credentials
Choose target Confluence space via a spaces modal
Mark spaces as favorites and fuzzy-search all accessible spaces
Trigger uploads via commands or custom hotkeys
extras: The Confluence API returns up to 250 spaces per request; the plugin adds a ?? fuzzy-search fallback to search all spaces the user can access. Feature requests and issues are tracked in the project's code repository.
motivation: The author wants to make it easy to write documentation in Obsidian and quickly create a Confluence page to share with team members.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot be shared directly as Confluence pages, so teams that document in Obsidian must copy content into Confluence manually.

relations.evidence: make it easy to write documentation on Obsidian and quicky create a Confluence page to share

summary: Confluence integration that uploads Obsidian Markdown notes as pages to an Atlassian Confluence instance.
